name: [RELEASE] Ultimate Gym Game
desc:
💪 ULTIMATE GYM GAME 💪
Lift, grow, bulk or cut, and become the strongest player in the gym! Train with 31+ exercises including Bench Press, Squat, Deadlift, Cable Machines, Dumbbells, Pull-Ups, Dips, and a full Calisthenics progression ending with the legendary Maltese.

⚠️ Sorry for Server restarts! I update the game alot with fixes. ⚠️

🔥 Features
Real muscle growth & strength progression
Strength / Hypertrophy / Endurance training zones
Global leaderboards & personal records
Overhead rank titles (Beginner → MR. UNIVERSE)
Earn cash, buy food & supplements, and mix buffs in your shaker
Mobile + Console support
KG/LBS toggle, inventory system, music player & more

🏆 Grind Smart. Eat Big. Get Huge.
